{{Quote|We're here to teach you a lesson, Suvam. And you as well, human. Unfortunately, you won't live to correct your mistakes.|A Trandoshan, to Suvam Tan and Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''skirmish on Yavin Station''' took place on the [[Yavin Station]] in [[3956 BBY]] when [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] invaded the station to settle their score with the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Suvam Tan]]. The [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] returned to the station for the third and final time on his mission and in conversation with Tan was forced to battle the pirates who [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked themselves]] in order to reach Tan undetected. But the confrontation was swift and saw the pirates defeated which saved Tan's life in the process.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Prelude==
{{Quote|They're trying to extort me, that's what! They think that just cause the Exchange is gone, they can take whatever they want from me! |Suvam Tan, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The former [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Suvam Tan]] assumed residence in the [[Yavin Station]] located above the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] in order to use it for his scavenging operations. Tan traveled often to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] where he would scavenge whatever he could find that could prove to be useful and would then trade the salvage to [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] or [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that would pass through. Tan provided them with the salvage in exchange for food and supplies so as to keep the station running. Tan also did business on occasion with the [[Exchange]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Davik Kang]] while Kang's [[Destruction of Taris|death]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] prompted the Trandoshan presence to grow agitated sensing a power vacuum that made their actions grow bolder.<ref name="KOTOR" />

The [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] (and former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]) [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] traveled to the station sometime after he left [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] (upon completing his [[Jedi training/Legends|re-training]]) when he found coordinates to the station in the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] on the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'' (the ship he stole from Kang following the latter's death). He arrived on the station and met with Tan (who learnt about Kang's death) while Revan returned a second time around the time he [[Skirmish aboard the Leviathan|learnt about his Sith past]]. It was on his second visit that he interrupted Trandoshan pirates threatening and intimidating Tan who accused him of holding out on them in terms of their arrangement and that the pirates wanted to change the deal. But Revan intervened and forced the Trandoshans to leave who vowed that their business was Tan was not concluded.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|We have our ways, rodian. Just because you didn't hear us dock, doesn't mean we can't. And your own stealth units have proven most... effective. |A Trandoshan, to Suvam Tan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
Revan returned to the space station after he [[Skirmish on Korriban|departed]] from [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and when he docked went to meet with Tan. But their conversation was short-lived as the Trandoshan pirates revealed themselves and said that their [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]] enabled them to board the station and reach Tan undetected. Revan failed to negotiate a peaceful end to the tense situation and was forced to defeat all the pirates when the pirates attacked. This saved Tan from further Trandoshan interference in his operations.<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Those Trandoshan scum! They couldn't get more out of me, so they tried to kill me instead! Hopefully, I'll have time before they send someone else to investigate... maybe rig their ship to take off somewhere else... Thank you for your help, at least. I know I couldn't have taken them on my own.|Suvam Tan, to Revan|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
Revan's actions saved Tan who in turn offered to sell Revan two rare items: the [[Mantle of the Force]] and the [[Heart of the Guardian]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The scenes that take place aboard the Yavin Station make their appearance in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' as an optional travel location that can be visited at any time after leaving Dantooine but before exploring [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]]. This can be sidestepped and the player can choose whether or not to visit the station at all.<ref name="KOTOR" />
